issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: cauldron, cornflower, brewing_stand, allium, candle, brick_stairs, white_wall_banner.
415 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.detail: Window boxes with trapdoor fronts, a slab door canopy with two hanging lanterns, candles, flower pots, a white carpet aisle and chain-hung lanterns over the ward.
notes.purpose: Brewing stand and cauldron by the beds and the white banner over the door make it read as a place of healing.
notes.depth: Window boxes and the canopy help the front, but the side and back walls are still one flat plane.
notes.roof: Same roof as L1; overhang warning is a false alarm (1 block all round). Gap under the front ridge at (5,6,1) remains.
notes.life: Flowers in boxes and lanterns at the door; no ground planting yet.

visual.summary: L1 plus brewing stand and cauldron, candles, hanging lanterns, window boxes, a door canopy and a banner: the ward now looks lived in and its purpose shows from the door.
problems: Front barge board hole under the ridge at (5,6,1) carried over from L1.
Side (x=2, x=8) and back walls stay flat; only the east-side window box at (9,1,4) breaks them.
Reachability: ward, aisle and lean-to reached; unreached are only roof slopes, window-box tops (3,2,1),(7,2,1),(9,2,4), the canopy top and shelf tops. Fine.
